# LED AD PRO

> LED billboard and digital out-of-home advertising in Bangladesh: 56 LED screens in 21 areas, plus static billboards, custom LED displays and event screens. Office: Flat A1, House 99 (1st floor), Road 10/2, Block D, Niketon, Gulshan 1, Dhaka. Sales and marketing +880 1958-503753, office +880 1316-743003, info@ledadpro.com.

## Locations
- [Agargaon](https://ledadpro.com/locations/agargaon/): 1 LED screen; Agargaon, in Sher-e-Bangla Nagar, is a government and institutional district with a metro rail station on MRT Line 6.
- [Airport](https://ledadpro.com/locations/airport/): 2 LED screens; The Airport area covers the approach to Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport on Airport Road and the Airport railway station.
- [Banani](https://ledadpro.com/locations/banani/): 1 LED screen; Banani sits between Gulshan and the airport corridor, with offices, restaurants and homes around the Chairmanbari U-loop.
- [Bogura](https://ledadpro.com/locations/bogura/): 1 LED screen; Bogura is a major city in northern Bangladesh and a trading hub for the region.
- [Chattogram](https://ledadpro.com/locations/chattogram/): 2 LED screens; Chattogram is Bangladesh’s port city and second-largest commercial centre, with Agrabad as its business district.
- [Cox's Bazar](https://ledadpro.com/locations/coxs-bazar/): 3 LED screens; Cox’s Bazar is the country’s best-known beach town, with hotels and tourist traffic along the Sughondha beach area.
- [Cumilla](https://ledadpro.com/locations/cumilla/): 1 LED screen; Cumilla is a city on the Dhaka–Chattogram corridor, with Kandirpar at its centre.
- [Dhanmondi & Science Lab](https://ledadpro.com/locations/dhanmondi/): 6 LED screens; Dhanmondi is a residential, education and shopping area, close to Science Lab, New Market and Shimanto Square.
- [Farmgate & Bijoy Sarani](https://ledadpro.com/locations/farmgate/): 2 LED screens; Farmgate and Bijoy Sarani form one of Dhaka’s busiest central junctions, near Khamarbari and the Parliament area.
- [Feni](https://ledadpro.com/locations/feni/): 1 LED screen; Feni is a town on the Dhaka–Chattogram highway.
- [Gulshan](https://ledadpro.com/locations/gulshan/): 10 LED screens; Gulshan is Dhaka’s diplomatic and business district, centred on Gulshan Circle-1 and Circle-2.
- [Kamlapur Railway Station](https://ledadpro.com/locations/kamlapur/): 2 LED screens; Kamlapur is Dhaka’s main railway station, serving intercity and commuter trains.
- [Karwan Bazar & Panthapath](https://ledadpro.com/locations/karwan-bazar/): 2 LED screens; Karwan Bazar and Panthapath form a business and media district, close to Bashundhara City and Sonargaon junction.
- [Mirpur](https://ledadpro.com/locations/mirpur/): 3 LED screens; Mirpur is one of Dhaka’s largest residential areas; Mirpur-10 Circle is a major junction with a metro rail station.
- [Mohakhali](https://ledadpro.com/locations/mohakhali/): 4 LED screens; Mohakhali links Gulshan, Banani and Tejgaon, with the Mohakhali flyover, bus terminal and the SKS Tower area.
- [Narayanganj](https://ledadpro.com/locations/narayanganj/): 1 LED screen; Narayanganj is a river port and industrial city south-east of Dhaka, including Fatullah.
- [Rajshahi](https://ledadpro.com/locations/rajshahi/): 2 LED screens; Rajshahi is a divisional city in the north-west, with Shaheb Bazar and New Market at its centre.
- [Rangpur](https://ledadpro.com/locations/rangpur/): 1 LED screen; Rangpur is a divisional city in the north, with Shapla Mor as a central junction.
- [Sadarghat Launch Terminal](https://ledadpro.com/locations/sadarghat/): 1 LED screen; Sadarghat on the Buriganga is Dhaka’s main river launch terminal for southern routes.
- [Sylhet](https://ledadpro.com/locations/sylhet/): 8 LED screens; Sylhet is a divisional city in the north-east, with screens at its main points from Bondor Bazar to the Surma.
- [Tejgaon & Hatirjheel](https://ledadpro.com/locations/tejgaon/): 2 LED screens; Tejgaon is a commercial and industrial area, with Hatirjheel’s lakeside roads and the GMG junction towards Gulshan.
